headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Accelerating purchase of second-hand homes for use as affordable rental housing
headlines.summary_en: On August 20, six Shanghai departments — the Municipal Housing and Urban-Rural Development Commission, the Municipal Housing Administration Bureau, the Municipal Finance Bureau, the PBOC Shanghai Branch, the Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau, and the Municipal Housing Provident Fund Management Center — jointly issued the Notice on Optimizing Municipal Real Estate Policy Measures, effective from August 21, 2026. The Notice stipulates demand-oriented measures aligned with the 15th Five-Year Plan's development requirements for affordable rental housing, promoting the acquisition of second-hand homes in central urban areas (including areas within the Outer Ring in Pudong) and accelerating renovation for leasing to increase the supply of affordable rental housing in central urban areas.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Promote housing voucher resettlement, accelerate acquisition of second-hand homes for affordable rental housing
headlines.summary_en: [Shanghai: Implementing Housing Voucher Resettlement, Accelerating Purchase of Second-hand Homes for Affordable Rental Housing] Six departments including the Shanghai Municipal Housing and Urban-Rural Development Management Commission, the Municipal Housing Administration Bureau, the Municipal Finance Bureau, the Shanghai Branch of the People's Bank of China, the Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau, and the Municipal Housing Provident Fund Management Center jointly issued the "Notice on Optimizing Municipal Real Estate Policies and Measures," effective from August 21, 2026. The notice clarifies efforts to intensify housing voucher implementation, adding housing voucher resettlement as an option in expropriation, demolition, and compensation arrangements, focusing on urban village redevelopment and old city renovation projects, balancing existing compensation standards, and offering multiple methods to meet residents' diverse resettlement needs.

headlines.title: 上海：出台阶段性购房补贴政策
headlines.summary: 一是实施“以旧换新”购房贷款补贴。在本《通知》实施之日起至2027年3月31日，居民家庭在本市外环外购买新建商品住房并完成合同网签备案，且在网签备案日前后1年内出售本市二手住房的，可向购入新建商品住房所在区房地产交易中心申请补贴。补贴金额按购买新建商品住房贷款总额的1%计算，单套住房最高补贴5万元；补贴总金额2亿元，用完即止。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Introducing phased home purchase subsidy policies
headlines.summary_en: First, implement a housing trade-in purchase loan subsidy. From the effective date of this Notice to March 31, 2027, resident households that purchase new commercial housing outside the Outer Ring and complete online contract filing, and sell their second-hand homes within one year before or after the filing date, may apply for a subsidy from the real estate trading center of the district where the new home is located. The subsidy is calculated at 1% of the total loan amount for the new home purchase, capped at 50,000 yuan per unit; the total subsidy pool is 200 million yuan, available on a first-come, first-served basis.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai issues 8 new property market measures today: targeted policies, up to 80,000 yuan in phased subsidies for 'sell old, buy new'
headlines.summary_en: [Shanghai Issues 8 New Real Estate Policies Today: Targeted Measures, Staged 'Sell Old, Buy New' Subsidy Up to 80,000 Yuan] After a six-month gap, Shanghai has rolled out new real estate policies. On August 20, six departments including the Shanghai Housing and Urban-Rural Development Commission, the Municipal Housing Administration Bureau, and the Municipal Finance Bureau jointly issued the "Notice on Optimizing Municipal Real Estate Policies and Measures," introducing 8 measures covering provident funds, personal housing loans, trade-ins, housing voucher resettlement, and second-hand home purchase. The new policies take effect from August 21.

headlines.summary_en: First, expand the scope of withdrawing housing provident fund for down payments. headlines.title: 2026世界动力电池大会将于9月3日至4日在四川宜宾举办
headlines.summary: 8月20日，省政府新闻办在四川新闻发布厅举行新闻发布会。会上，省政府副秘书长田成川介绍，世界动力电池大会是经国家批准，由四川省人民政府主办的全国唯一、具有世界影响力的动力电池产业国际性会议。经国务院批准，2026世界动力电池大会将于9月3日至4日在四川省宜宾市举办。大会围绕行业政策、前沿技术、创新应用、新型储能、电池回收等设置8个专题会议，聚焦关键技术、产业转型开展深度对话，将发布《动力电池产业发展指数（2026）》《动力电池技术路线图》、2026年动力电池领域创新技术等成果。

headlines.title_en: 2026 World Power Battery Conference to be held September 3-4 in Yibin, Sichuan
headlines.summary_en: On August 20, the provincial government information office held a press conference in the Sichuan News Hall. At the conference, Deputy Secretary-General of the provincial government Tian Chengchuan noted that the World Power Battery Conference is the country's only international conference on the power battery industry with global influence, approved by the state and hosted by the People's Government of Sichuan Province. With State Council approval, the 2026 World Power Battery Conference will be held on September 3-4 in Yibin City, Sichuan Province. The conference will feature eight special sessions covering industry policy, frontier technologies, innovative applications, new energy storage, and battery recycling, with in-depth dialogues on key technologies and industrial transformation, and will release the Power Battery Industry Development Index (2026), the Power Battery Technology Roadmap, and achievements in innovative power battery technologies for 2026.
